shard_design.reason: Bounds temporary raw storage and runtime while preserving the frozen history exactly.

required_per_shard_checks: all requested symbol-date pairs produce genuine rows inside the exact UTC day
target_begin_ms <= exchTimeMs < target_end_ms for every admitted tick
historical schema normalization is lossless and records which schema was observed
completed 15m state timestamps are monotonic and unique
no completed state escapes its requested UTC day
finite mid_last is present for later causal labeling
every downloaded raw archive is SHA256 hashed
raw archive is deleted after compact aggregation
no forward-return label or economic metric is computed by the bank builder

merge_rules.input: only shards whose manifests pass all required checks

governance: Sharding cannot add, remove or reselect symbols or dates based on profitability.
Historical evaluation dates remain separate from teacher training dates.
A successful bank build proves data integrity only, not predictive edge.
Any economic learner using this bank must be separately frozen before its historical evaluation is observed.
